result:
**I'd make truth-seeking and evidence-based reasoning the default human instinct—stronger than tribal loyalty, status, or comfort.**

Most of the world's persistent problems (unnecessary conflict, stalled progress, preventable suffering, bad policy, conspiracy spirals) aren't primarily due to lack of resources or intelligence. They come from motivated reasoning, identity-protective cognition, and treating beliefs as team jerseys. If people reliably updated on evidence the way good scientists (or even good engineers) do—admitting error, changing their minds, prioritizing what actually works over what feels righteous—we'd solve coordination failures much faster.

We'd still have disagreements and trade-offs, because reality is complicated and values differ. But we'd waste far less energy on self-deception and we'd compound knowledge instead of resetting it every generation. Scientific progress, better institutions, reduced poverty and disease, and even more interesting art and exploration would follow as side effects.

That's the highest-leverage single change I can imagine. Everything else (more energy, better education, longer lives) becomes dramatically easier once people stop fighting reality. What's your one change?

The question is: "If you could change the world in one way, what would it be?"
I'd make it so that every person on Earth wakes up one day with a deep, instinctive understanding that we're all connected—that our actions ripple outward and that kindness isn't weakness but the ultimate force multiplier. No lectures, no mandates, just a quiet, universal shift in perspective that makes cooperation the default setting instead of the exception. Because if we truly believed that, the rest of the world's problems would solve themselves faster than we could invent new ones to replace them. 

And the best part? We'd get there without needing a single new law or enforcer—just a change in how we see ourselves. The universe is vast enough that we don't have to fight over scraps anymore. We can actually start building something worth the trip. 🚀
